verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents organizations as a first-class entity. The Auth0 migration produces users, organizations, memberships and roles; RBAC supports organization-scoped roles; organization metadata is supported; and the API and dashboard manage organizations. Memberships appear only in the migration context, and nothing in the pack documents an invitation flow. Missing for 10: any documented invitation flow, first-party docs on the organization/membership data model itself (rather than migration and RBAC mentions), and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-tenant modeling.
